_comment: Английские подписи флагов для «Я» → «Что со мной было» (scenes/_memos.json). Переведены все жизни (27.11). Правишь русский — правь и здесь.

F_Т01.СПОР: At seven I raced Vitka to the snag. I didn't make it.
F_Т01.БУБЛИК: At seven I jumped into the backwater after Bublik. Bublik made it out.
F_Т01.ЧАСЫ: At seven I dove for the glint by the snag and came up with a watch in my fist. It's stopped at 4:12.
F_Т01.ДОЛГ: At seven I ran for the grown-ups, and Vitka stayed in the water. I owe him.

F_Т02.ЧЕЙ: Under the water somebody asked me, "Whose kid are you?"
F_Т02.ХОР: Under the water somebody was counting along with the girl. Lots of voices.
F_Т02.ЛИЦО: Under the water I looked down and saw myself on the sand, with an old man over me.
F_Т02.МАМА: Under the water I called for Mom, and a stranger's palm lay on my forehead.

F_Т03.ШРАМ: Punched Shmelyov for calling me Vodyanoy, and whatever happened, happened.
F_Т03.ВОДЯНОЙ: Made the nickname Vodyanoy my own.
F_Т03.ЗАМЕТКА: Put up notices, and the Kuzbass paper wrote about it: looking for the old man in the striped shirt.
F_Т03.ВОДОБОЯЗНЬ: Swore never to talk about water again.

F_Т04.РЕЛЬСЫ: Sat on the railroad tracks with Dad in ninety-eight.
F_Т04.РЫНОК: Sold frying pans at the market with Mom.
F_Т04.ЦВЕТМЕТ: Cut cable for scrap copper with Vitka.
F_Т04.ОЛИМПИАДА: Went to the math olympiad with Nina Petrovna.

F_Т05.ТЕТРАДИ: Read Granddad's notebooks. I remember a sentence in the margin.
F_Т05.ФОТО: I know who the second man in Granddad's photo is.
F_Т05.ПРОДАЛ: Sold Granddad's box to the junk dealer for Sega cartridges.
F_Т05.СОЖЖЕНО: Gave Granddad's box to Dad. Dad burned it.

F_Т06.ПЕРЕПЛЫЛ: Swam across Black Backwater with Nika.
F_Т06.ТАЙНА_НИКИ: Told Nika about the dark under the water. Nobody else.
F_Т06.ПАЦАНЫ: Laughed at "the Novosibirsk girl" with the guys.
F_Т06.БАКЕНЩИК: The buoy keeper told me about a man who stands by the backwater every July.

F_Т07.КЛЮЧИ: Yanked the keys out of Vitka's Lada Nine on the ice.
F_Т07.ЛЁД: Drove across the frozen Tom. My body remembers what to do.
F_Т07.СДАЛ: Called Dad from a pay phone so Vitka wouldn't drive on the ice.
F_Т07.ВИДЕНИЕ: Saw Vitka go under the ice. In this world he didn't.

F_Т08.ПАЛЫЧ: Hauled air tanks for the mine rescuers for three nights while Dad was underground.
F_Т08.ДОМ: Held it together at home for three nights, for Mom and Sonka.
F_Т08.ТОРГ: Went to the backwater for three nights and bargained with the water for Dad.
F_Т08.ДАТЧИКИ: Found out why the Glubokaya blew and told a reporter.

F_Т09.АРМИЯ: Gave Vitka a proper send-off to the army.
F_Т09.ДОЛГ_СВАРНОМУ: Helped Vitka dodge the draft through Welder. Now I owe Welder.
F_Т09.НИКА: Went to the dacha with Nika instead of Vitka's send-off.
F_Т09.ДВЕРЬ: In the garage Dad said, "Under the mine. There was a door down there."

F_ЗНАЕТ: I've already died once. I remember it like a memory.
F_ЗНАЕТ_ДЕДА: I know who my grandfather was.
F_ГИПОКСИЯ: Survived methane at the coalface. Sometimes my head aches in a particular way.

F_В201.УЧЁБА: Top of the class in seminars.
F_В201.ЖЕЛЕЗО: Unloaded freight cars at the Tomsk-2 yard.
F_В201.КОМПАНИЯ: Lived the dorm life: guitar, the comedy team.
F_В201.ТИШИНА: Went down to the embankment at night to listen to the water.

F_В204.СКЕПТИК: Called Lunyov sick and walked out. Then came back.
F_В204.ОТЕЦ: Called Dad from the department corridor. For the first time he talked about Granddad.
F_В204.МИТЯ: I know who Lunyov waited for at the backwater every July.

F_В205.ПРАВДА: Told Nika everything: the elevator, Granddad, Tuning Fork.
F_В205.РАБОТА: I keep my distance from Nika.
F_В205.СВИДАНИЕ: Walked around Tomsk with Nika until late at night.
F_В205.УБРАЛ: Asked them to take Nika off the project: it's dangerous to be near me.

F_В206.ОТКАЗАЛ: Turned Gleb down: you don't bring back the dead.
F_В206.ВРАЧ: Took Gleb to a doctor by force.

F_В207.С_НИКОЙ: Agreed to the Protocol, as long as Nika was at the monitor.

F_В208.ЭТАЛОН: Stayed in the dark to the end and heard it all.
F_В208.ПРЕРВАЛ: Lunged for the light, and Lunyov stopped the session.

F_ПРОТОКОЛ: I know Granddad's protocol down to the last line. Cold, a screen, four-twelve.

F_В210.ИНСТИТУТ: Left for the institute outside Moscow.
F_В210.С_НИКОЙ: Left for the institute together with Nika.
F_В210.ОТЕЦ: Went to see Dad before the institute.

F_В211.СЛУШАЛ: Heard my first stranger's death through to the end.
F_В211.СОРВАЛ: Tore the wires off my head on my first assignment.

F_В212.РАБОТА: Did the job. I'm an instrument.
F_В212.ПОЕХАЛ: Drove to the railroad crossing myself.

F_ЗНАЕТ_ШАДРИНА: I know who tampered with the gas water heater.

F_В215.ПОБЕГ: Agreed for show and planned an escape.

F_В217.СИДЕЛ: Sat with Lunyov until he fell asleep.
F_В217.ДЕВЯНОСТО_ШЕСТОЙ: Lunyov told me what happened in '96.

F_В218.ПРИБОРЫ: I'm getting the instruments ready for the twenty-eighth of July.

F_В220.ПРОЧЁЛ: Read Lunyov's letter in the cell.
F_В220.ОТДАЛ: Gave Lunyov's letter to the investigator unread.
F_В220.ПОТОМ: Hid Lunyov's letter in a book. I'll read it later.

F_МИТЯ: I know about Mitya, Lunyov's son.
F_ОБРАЗЕЦ: I know where the two vials of my blood went.
F_ЧАСЫ_ЛУНЁВА: I wear Granddad's Shturmanskie watch from Lunyov's drawer.

F_ПАРТНЁР.ТАНЯ: Tanya is beside me. She doesn't hand me a lamp anymore; she hides it.
F_ПАРТНЁР.ПЛОЙ: Ploy is beside me. Under the water she holds my hand.
F_ПАРТНЁР.ЛЕРА: Lera is beside me. Her scar is on her arm, and I remember which one.
F_ПАРТНЁР.САРДААНА: Sardaana is beside me. She measures mammoths with her mother's flowery tape measure.

F_В222.ПРОЧЁЛ: Read Granddad's letter aloud to Dad, to the end.
F_В222.ПРАВДА: Told Dad the truth: we're both the lucky kind.
F_В222.МОЛЧАЛ: Kept quiet with Dad, the way he kept quiet all his life.
F_В222.ЧАСЫ: Put Granddad's watch in Dad's palm.

F_В223.МОРЕ: Saw the sea for the first time in my life. It holds you up by itself.
F_В223.ПРАВДА: Told them why I've walked the embankment at five in the morning for twenty years.
F_В223.СОНЬКА: Went to Sonka's birthday party. Mom said, "Two of you."
F_В223.ОСТАЛСЯ: Turned in my ticket to the sea. At the end of July is when people drown in the Tom most.

F_ТИМУР: Timur from sixth grade, class A, stayed under the ice.

F_В224.ПРАВДА: Told the journalists what the Second Chance is made of.
F_В224.УЕХАЛ: Turned the foundation down and stayed out of it.

F_ДАША.УЧЕНИЦА: I'm teaching Dasha to listen and not be afraid.
F_ДАША.ОТКАЗ: Stepped aside when Dasha needed help.
F_ДАША.СПРЯТАЛ: Talked Dasha's parents out of taking her to the clinic.

F_ДАША_ЗАБРАЛИ: Dasha was taken to the Orpheus clinic.

F_В701.НИКА: Answered Nika with a long letter.
F_В701.ОЛЯ: Went to the movies with Olya from the next stairwell.

F_В703.ВАРЯ: Got Varya to the pharmacy alive. In another world I didn't.

F_В704.ТЕСТЬ: Dragged my father-in-law out of the banya into the snow.
F_В704.ПОМНИЛ: Dragged my father-in-law out of the banya because I remembered how people fall asleep in there. The next morning he had a different father.
F_В704.УМЕР: Walked out of the banya alone. My father-in-law stayed on the bench, and there was no going back for him.

F_В706.ДВЕРЬ: Pulled Varya out of the burning kids' room.
F_В706.ЗНАНИЕ: Went back to eight in the evening and didn't plug in the lights. Varya has written with her left hand ever since.

F_В705.ВИШНЯ: Let the oncoming KAMAZ by. The silver Granta turned cherry red.
F_В705.ПЕРВЫЙ: Passed the semi right behind the KAMAZ, because I remembered it.
F_В705.ВТОРОЙ: Passed the semi only after the second KAMAZ, the one that wasn't there the first time.

F_В708.СПАС: Pulled Kolka out from under the ice.
F_В708.ПОМНИЛ: Ran around Kolka along the bank, because I remembered where the ice was thin. Now Kolka's scar is on the other knee.

F_В709.ПРАВДА: Told my wife about the icicle, the lights and the pond.
F_В709.РАЗВЕДКА: I died on Varya's road so I'd know what was waiting for her.

F_ЖЕНА.ЖИВА: Noticed my wife was tired, and got there in time.
F_ЖЕНА.УМЕРЛА: My wife has been gone since '47.

F_В101.ОТЕЦ: My first year underground, I stuck close to Dad.
F_В101.МИХАЛЫЧ: My first year underground, I stuck close to Mikhalych. He taught me to hear the seam crack.
F_В101.ТАНЯ: Lingered after shifts at the lamp room window. Tanya poured me tea from a thermos.
F_В101.НИКА: Called Nika in Novosibirsk every evening.

F_КОНВЕРТ: Dad opened the envelope "For Kolya." Granddad went too deep.

F_В105.ВГСЧ: Joined the mine rescue under Palych. Seventh man.
F_В105.БРИГАДА: Stayed on Dad's crew. Learned to listen to the silence.
F_В105.УЧАСТОК: Enrolled by correspondence at the polytechnic to become a mining foreman. A section of my own.

F_В106.МОЛЧАЛ: At Nika's wedding I kept quiet and danced with her aunt.
F_В106.СКАЗАЛ: At Nika's wedding I told her. Twenty-six steps.
F_В106.СМЕНА: Left Nika's wedding drunk and went to the mine. Tanya wouldn't give me a lamp.

F_ЗАКЛЕИЛ: Put a bag over the methane sensor in the seventh longwall. Three turns of electrical tape.

F_В109.ВЫТАЩИЛ: Pulled Vitka out from under the beam.
F_В109.ПОМОЩЬ: Went for help. Vitka lives without his legs.
F_В109.РАСЧЁТ: Vitka gave me his self-rescuer. We're even.

F_В110.СЧЁТ: Dad and I counted how many times we'd died. He has eight.
F_В110.ДВЕРЬ: Asked my dying father about Krasnaya Gorka. He turned away.
F_В110.ПИСЬМО: Put Granddad's letter in Dad's hand.
F_В110.ТАНЯ: Brought Tanya to Dad. He asked her father's forgiveness.

F_ОБЪЕКТ: Found Granddad's chamber at Facility Level 640, and his log.

F_В501.МАМА: Called Mom from Tolmachevo and told her I was flying to Thailand.
F_В501.ВРАНЬЁ: Texted Mom that I was on a business trip. She wrote back, "Stay away from the water."
F_В501.НИКА: Nika saw me off at Tolmachevo, on the metal chairs.
F_В501.АНГЛИЙСКИЙ: Before the flight I learned forty English phrases. The one that stuck best was "Help me, please."

F_В503.САМ: Rode down the hill to Chalok on my own; the pickup with the ice drove past.
F_В503.ШЛЕМ: Caught the helmet Ploy threw me. White, with a chipped edge.
F_В503.ПЕШКОМ: Walked over the hill and twisted my ankle. Ploy taped it up.

F_В504.МЭ: Made it to Ploy's mother in the big flood. She calls me "the son from the roof."
F_В504.МОСТ: Sat out the night on the bridge in the big flood. Ploy's mother waited on the balcony until morning.

F_В505.ДЕРЖАЛ: At thirty meters I held on to Vika from Barnaul.
F_В505.ОТПУСТИЛ: At thirty meters I let go of Vika. By the rules. Her leg goes numb before rain.

F_В506.МОНАХ: Stayed at the forest monastery for a second rainy season. I have Luang Pho's bowl.
F_В506.СВАДЬБА: Took off the robe and brought Ploy a ring from the market in Ubon.
F_В506.ВОПРОС: Asked Luang Pho who whispers under the water. He drew circles on the ground.
F_В506.ОСТРОВ: Came back from the monastery to the island. I wear a coin with a hole in it around my neck.

F_В507.СОМЧАЙ: I fill my tanks at Somchai's for half price. His air tastes sweet.
F_В507.СВОЙ: Bought my own compressor on credit. Its air has no taste.
F_В507.ПРОБА: Took Somchai's air to be tested. Somchai moved the intake pipe to the roof.

F_В508.ПРОШЁЛ: Carried the tanks through the squeeze in the cave, to the third chamber.
F_В508.НАВЕРХУ: Hauled tanks at the cave entrance, to the pumps.

F_В509.СМОТРЕЛ: Watched Dad's funeral on my phone to the end.
F_В509.МОРЕ: Switched off Dad's funeral and went out to sea.
F_В509.МАМА: At Dad's funeral I talked to Mom on the phone. "Stay away from the water."

F_В510.РЕБЯТА: Took the guys from the last flights into the Tom dumpling shop.
F_В510.ТИХО: Hung a sign in the Tom: no politics.
F_В510.НИКА: Sat with Nika at night in the Tom's kitchen, among the flour sacks.
F_В510.ПЛОЙ: On Fridays I closed the Tom and went out to sea with Ploy.

F_В511.ФАРАНГ: In the big flood I took a Dutchman off a roof who didn't need it.
F_В511.ШКОЛА: In the big flood I took children off the school roof. The Dutchman stayed on his.

F_В512.ПРИЕДУ: Promised Sonka I'd come to Mom as soon as the planes were allowed to fly.
F_В512.ВИДЕО: Recorded a video for Mom with a turtle. She doesn't recognize me in it.

F_МАЛИ: I have a daughter. Mali, Thai for "jasmine."
F_ТАБЛЕТКИ: I take Anna Markovna's pills. The voices are behind them, as if behind cotton wool.

F_В601.ПРАВДА: Told Anna Markovna everything about the voices, just as it is. She wrote them down in three columns.
F_В601.МОЛЧУ: Told Anna Markovna it was all over. She didn't believe me.
F_В601.ТЕТРАДЬ: Started a green notebook in three columns. Who, what they say, when.
F_В601.ТАБЛЕТКИ: At the Regional Hospital I took everything they gave me, just so it would go quiet.

F_В603.ТАБЛЕТКИ: After I was discharged I took my pills and lived at home, quietly.
F_В603.СЛУШАТЬ: After I was discharged I flushed the pills down the toilet and started listening to them.
F_В603.ОТЕЦ: Dad told me about the cold at the back of his neck. In '89 he turned his crew around.

F_В604.ГОЛОС: In the fog on the Multa I told a living voice from a dead one.
F_В604.МАТ: In the fog on the Multa I walked toward the one who was swearing. The living swear.
F_В604.ЖДАЛ: Sat the night out on the pass while they called. Two fingers on my left hand have no nails.

F_В605.МРАССУ: Went to the Mras-Su, to an old man who doesn't send people away.
F_В605.ВИТЬКА: Asked Vitka to come to the taiga with me. He came.
F_В605.НИКА: Nika said I'm just Andrei who sleeps badly.

F_В606.ПОСТ: Stood the night through in the icy chapel on the ninth day of the fast.
F_В606.ХЛЕБ: Ate Father Serafim's crust of bread.
F_В606.ПОПОЛАМ: Broke the crust in half with Father Serafim.
F_В606.ПЕЧКА: Prayed by the stove. Once already I'd frozen to the floorboards in that chapel.

F_КАМЕРТОН: I wear Father Serafim's tuning fork on a cord.

F_В607.ЛЮДИ: Went out to the people who came to the hermitage. Listened to them all day.
F_В607.ГНАЛ: Drove the people away from the hermitage. The hermitage is not a circus.
F_В607.ГОЛОС: Took dictation from the one who studied in Tomsk. Burned half of it.
F_В607.ОТЕЦ: Told Dad who his father was.

F_В608.ВЫДЕРЖАЛ: At Epiphany I broke free from under their palms and said, "Enough."
F_В608.ПРАВДА: At Epiphany I told them, "I die like you do. I just remember."
F_В608.НИКА: At Epiphany Nika led me off the ice: "He's my patient."
F_В608.УШЁЛ: At Epiphany I walked off the ice without them. Vitka stayed.
F_В608.ВЕРЁВКА: At Epiphany I tied a rope around myself. It was held by someone who needs me alive.

F_В609.ЧУЖИЕ: I hear strangers in my pitch. They don't die, they rewind.
F_В609.МИТЯ: In the Choir a boy is crying who isn't mine. Mitya Lunyov.
F_В609.НИКА: Wrote to Nika about the voices in my pitch. She went to Krasny Prospekt.
F_В609.ДРОВА: Split firewood for two days so as not to hear the strangers in my pitch.

F_В610.РЕКА: Got away from the wildfire downhill, across the burn. A burn doesn't burn twice.
F_В610.РУЧЕЙ: Lay out the wildfire in a stream under a wet sheepskin coat. The cabin burned down.
F_В610.ВЕТЕР: Turned the wind. Stepan's winter cabin burned down.

F_В611.ПЛОТ: Lashed a raft together out of barrels in Mezhdurechensk.
F_В611.БЕРЕГ: Walked downriver, along the railroad ties by the river.

F_В612.НАПРЯМИК: Crossed the settling ponds straight across.
F_В612.ХОР: Crossed the settling ponds with my eyes closed, on the living side.
F_В612.ДАМБА: Went around the settling ponds along the dam, eight kilometers in the heat.
F_В612.ТРУБА: Crossed the settling ponds on a pipe, like walking a log.

F_В202.ПОТОЛОК: In the elevator with the nitrogen, I climbed up under the ceiling, to the grate.
F_В202.СТОП: In the elevator with the nitrogen, I hit Stop and squeezed out through the gap.

F_ОДЕЯЛО: Went into the burning kids' room under a wet blanket.

F_В401.ВЕСЫ: Kept count of the metal on Welder's scales.
F_В401.ГРУЗЧИК: Hauled metal at Welder's scrap yard.
F_В401.ФУРЫ: Rode shotgun as a freight hand in Welder's Bychok truck.

F_В402.КЛИН: Jammed a frozen chicken leg in the freezer door so it wouldn't slam shut.
F_В402.СТЕНА: Left the warehouse along the wall, where the dog can't reach.
F_В402.СТОРОЖ: Called the watchman by name out of the dark. He knows Dad.

F_В403.ЗАБОЙ: Went into the wildcat pit with Vitka as a coal digger.
F_В403.ВОДИЛА: Hauled coal from the wildcat pits in a Bychok truck.
F_В403.БАТЯ: Told Dad about the wildcat pit. He explained how to listen to the props.

F_СТОЙКА: In the wildcat pit I wedged a larch prop under the crack.

F_В404.БРОСИЛ: Climbed out of the wildcat pit alone. It took five hours to dig Vitka out.
F_В404.ВЫТАЩИЛ: Carried Vitka out of the wildcat pit on my back.
F_В404.БАДЬЯ: Held up the roof with my shoulder while Shurup lowered the bucket.
F_В404.ПЕЧЬ: Dragged Vitka into the old furnace, under the sandstone. They dug us out.

F_В406.ВЫИГРАЛ: Won the Drum. Tyoma from Osinniki lost.
F_В406.УШЁЛ: Got up from the Drum and walked out to whistles.
F_В406.ТЁМА: Took Tyoma away from the Drum. They beat us both.

F_В407.ПРАВДА: Told Nika about the wildcat pits and the club.
F_В407.ВРАНЬЁ: Lied to Nika and put her on the train.
F_В407.ТЕТРАДЬ: Gave Nika Welder's notebook from the scales.

F_В408.САПЁР: I work for Shadrin as a living sapper.

F_АРХИВ: I have Granddad's notebook from Shadrin's archive.

F_В409.СКАЗАЛ: Told Shadrin who was sitting in the kitchen. There was shooting.
F_В409.ПАРЕНЬ: Let the kid out of the kitchen through the yard.
F_В409.ОТКАЗ: Didn't go into the meeting. Said it was a gut feeling.

F_В410.УЕХАЛ: Left the zone with Lera, away from Shadrin.
F_В410.ПРАВДА: Told Lera how many times I've died.

F_В411.ВОШЁЛ: Went in to Dad past the car at the entrance.
F_В411.ШАДРИН: Called Shadrin to get the car at the hospital moved.
F_В411.СОНЬКА: Didn't go to Dad. Sonka brought the storm jacket.
F_В411.ВИТЬКА: Went to Vitka instead of Dad.

F_В412.ПЕРЕШЁЛ: In '49 I crossed Sovetsky the way I had all my life.
F_В412.ПЕРЕХОД: In '49 I went the long way, through the underpass.
F_В412.ЛЕВО: I know that here we drive on the left now.

F_В301.РЮКЗАК: My first summer I carried forty million years in a backpack behind Zoya Arkadyevna.
F_В301.МОЛОТОК: Zoya Arkadyevna taught me to listen to stone with a hammer.
F_В301.ЛОШАДИ: My first summer I looked after the horses with Miron Todyshev. The chestnut was called Chalkan.

F_В302.КЕДР: On the bald peak I sat away from the cedar, behind the roots. The strike went into the cedar.
F_В302.МОЛОТОК: On the bald peak I threw off the backpack with the hammer. The hammer's pick is melted now.
F_В302.ГРИВКА: On the bald peak I sat on a little ridge while a mudflow went down the hollow beside me.

F_В303.МИФ: Uncle Gosha told me Granddad wanted to turn the Tom back. Not the water. Time.
F_В303.МИТЯ: Uncle Gosha told me about Mitka, a graduate student's son who drowned in our backwater.
F_В303.УШЁЛ: Went off to sleep by the horses when Uncle Gosha started in about Granddad.

F_В304.ПОЛИТЕХ: Studied geology by correspondence in Tomsk.
F_В304.СЕВЕР: Went north as a laborer. Studying can wait.
F_В304.СОНЬКА: Took Sonka out into the field. Miron gave her a bridle.

F_В305.БЕГОМ: Ran to camp with a wet foot at fifty below. A fool, but a healthy one.
F_В305.СНЕГ: On the ice overflow I dried my felt boot with snow.
F_В305.КОСТЁР: On the ice overflow I dried my foot by the fire. Two toes on my right foot stayed behind in Yakutsk.

F_В306.ТОРГ: Haggled three hours out of the tusk hunters for Sardaana, like at the market in '98.
F_В306.РАЗГОВОР: Told the tusk hunters the truth about myself, and they let us go.
F_В306.УВЁЛ: Drove Sardaana away from the tusk hunters. She called me a living coward.
F_В306.ПУСТОТА: Heard with my hammer that the tunnel in the permafrost was about to cave in.

F_В307.КАБИНА: When the plane came down on the ridge, I went straight for Vitka.
F_В307.САЛОН: When the plane came down on the ridge, first I pushed Sardaana and the others outside.
F_В307.ОГНЕТУШИТЕЛЬ: When the plane came down on the ridge, first I put out the fire with the extinguisher.

F_В308.РВАНУЛ: Tore Vitka out of the cockpit by force. His boot stayed under the pedal.
F_В308.ПЕДАЛЬ: Pried the pedals back with a tire iron and carried Vitka out on my back.
F_В308.САПОГ: Cut Vitka's boot open, and his foot came out by itself.
F_В308.БЛИСТЕР: Pushed Vitka up through the window, toward the sky.
F_В308.БРОСИЛ: Left Vitka in the burning cockpit. Kostya pulled him out.

F_В309.ЗАМЕР: Took the readings on the mound to the last second and got out in time.
F_В309.УВЁЛ: Dropped the instruments at the mound and got everyone out at a run.
F_В309.ЗВОН: Drove my hammer into the ice of the mound and left when the ringing broke off.
F_В309.ПОПЕРЁК: Led everyone away from the mound at a walk, against the wind. Afterward the lake turned round.

F_В310.СЛУШАЛ: At the station I wrote the strangers down in the log, under "Phenomena."
F_В310.УЕХАЛ: Left the station for people, for somewhere noisy.
F_В310.ВИТЬКА: Wrote Vitka twelve pages from the station.

F_В311.СКАЗАЛ: On the train I told Nika that it was me she was counting.
F_В311.ОБРАЗЕЦ: On the train Nika told me about the two vials of my blood. I didn't tell her who I am.
F_В311.СОШЁЛ: Got off the train in Yurga and didn't go back to the compartment.

F_В312.ПРОЧЁЛ: Worked through Granddad's letters in the winter cabin. The protocol is in my notebook.
F_В312.ВЗЯЛ: Read Granddad's letters to Gosha one a day, until spring.
F_В312.СЖЁГ: Burned Granddad's letters by the stream. The ash went into the Tom.

F_В120.ПЛАН: Gave Seryoga the bag for the sensor. The quota comes first.
F_В120.СТОП: Stopped the seventh longwall with my signature on the work order.
F_В120.ВЕНТИЛЯТОР: Got a fan for the junction. A week of downtime is on me.

F_В121.ЛЕНТА: Rode the conveyor belt to the fire, lying on the coal.
F_В121.ПЕШКОМ: Ran a kilometer and a half down the drift. Seryoga breathed in too much.
F_В121.ТРОС: Remembered where the belt dives under the drum, and yanked the cable.

F_В122.ЛОМ: Got Yegorka down off the slag heap, tapping the crust with a crowbar.
F_В122.ПО_ИМЕНИ: Called Yegorka by name, and he climbed down in his own footprints.
F_В122.ОЖОГ: Waited for the bulldozer. Yegorka got burned; Vitka didn't speak for a year.
F_В122.ПОЛЫНЬ: Remembered where the crust holds: upwind, along the wormwood.

F_В123.ОТКАЗ: Didn't sign the report. Put out the slag heap the honest way.
F_В123.ТАНЯ: Didn't sign the report and left for Tanya, on Krasnaya Gorka.

F_ВОДЯНЫЕ.СЕКЦИЯ: Started the Vodyanoys swimming club at the school. Thirty-one names on the roll.
F_ВОДЯНЫЕ.ПИРС: Pried open the OSVOD lifeguard hut with a crowbar and taught everyone who came to swim.
F_ВОДЯНЫЕ.ВДВОЁМ: We taught swimming together: me in the water, her on the shore.
F_ВОДЯНЫЕ.СОНЬКА: I taught swimming, Sonka taught resuscitation.
F_ВОДЯНЫЕ.ХОР: Didn't open the hut. Listened to the Choir and got to where people were drowning in time.

F_МОСТ.УГОВОРИЛ: Talked Yegor down off the railing of the Kuznetsky Bridge.
F_МОСТ.ПРЫГНУЛ: Yegor jumped off the bridge. The video got two million views.
F_МОСТ.ОТЕЦ: Called Dimka to get Yegor off the bridge. Yegor never came back.
F_МОСТ.ДЕРЖАЛ: Held Yegor by the ankle, lying on the bridge. My shoulder has ached ever since.

F_П101.СВАРНОЙ: In '96 I went to Welder and told him I knew about the copper.
F_П101.ШАДРИН: In '96 I sold Shadrin what I know about the mines.
F_П101.ТИХО: In '96 I borrowed a hundred dollars and waited for the default.

F_П102.КРОВЬ: In '98 I bought the blood out from under Lunyov's buyers.
F_П102.СЖЁГ: In '98 Welder and I burned the blood behind the hotel.
F_П102.ВЫЛИЛ: In '98 Lunyov poured the blood into a trash can on the stairs.
F_П102.ШАДРИН: In '98 I gave the blood to Shadrin.
F_П102.ПРОДАЛ: In '98 I watched Lunyov sell the blood and didn't touch it.

F_П103.ПРАВДА: I told him who I am, starting from the snag.

F_П401.МОЛЧА: By the kiosk I said nothing to Dad.
F_П401.ЛЁГКИЕ: By the kiosk I told Dad to look after his lungs.
F_П401.ПЛАВАТЬ: By the kiosk I asked Dad to teach his son to swim.
F_П401.ДЕД: By the kiosk I passed Granddad's "Synchronize watches" on to Dad.

F_П402.ПРОСИЛ: At dawn I asked the doctor from Tomsk not to sell anything.
F_П402.СВОИ: At dawn I didn't go up to the man without a fishing rod.

F_РАЗВЕДЧИК: I died three times on Varya's highway in a single morning and talked her down it minute by minute.
